post.caption: Freud's secret society wore matching rings. Sigmund Freud collected ancient carved stones. Before the First World War, he formed a secret committee of psychoanalysts. He gave each member a gold ring set with an ancient stone. Each stone carried a mythological scene, chosen for the person. In 2018, a curator in Jerusalem found a box labeled Freud Nike. Inside was a gold signet ring Freud had given to Eva Rosenfeld. A show called Freud of the Rings displayed six rings together. Over the years, Freud handed out about twenty rings.
